title: Voyah Radio 0.3.9
notes:
First GitHub release of Voyah Radio, the internet radio companion for the Voyah Free center display and Open Voyah Controls.

- Browse stations from Belarus, Russia, Kazakhstan, and other countries. Search by station name or frequency, save favorites, and arrange or hide stations.
- Resume the last station and tab when opening the app, with an option to disable automatic playback. Change stations with steering-wheel or media controls and keep listening in the background.
- Follow the current station in the list and see track details when the station provides them. The player keeps its controls in place during station changes and long connection messages.
- Choose graphite or amber, a live spectrum or waveform, and a skippable startup animation. The interface is available in English, Russian, and Kazakh.
- Check for new releases and download signed updates from Settings.

Install **VoyahRadio-v0.3.9.apk** on the head unit. Requires Android 9 or later and an internet connection for streaming.
